name: Titanium.UI.iPad.Popover
summary: A Popover is used to manage the presentation of content in a popover.
description:
A popover is created using the [Titanium.UI.iPad.createPopover](api:Titanium.UI.iPad#createPopover) method or **`<Popover>`** Alloy element.

Popovers are used to present information temporarily, but in a way that does not take over
the entire screen in the way that a modal view does. The popover content is layered on top of
the existing content in a special type of window. The popover remains visible until the user
taps outside of the popover window or it is explicitly dismissed.

Do not add top-level view containers, such as a `SplitWindow` or `TabGroup`, to a popover.
Adding top-level view containers may have unintended side effects. See the [contentView](api:Titanium.UI.iPad.Popover#contentView)
property for more information.

examples.title: Simple Popover with a Title and Right Button
Alloy XML Markup

properties.name: arrowDirection
properties.summary: Indicates the arrow direction of the popover.
properties.description:
Use this property to indicate the popover arrows to use.  You can bitwise-OR the constant
values together.

Do not set this property to [Titanium.UI.iPad.POPOVER_ARROW_DIRECTION_UNKNOWN](api:Titanium.UI.iPad#POPOVER_ARROW_DIRECTION_UNKNOWN).

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.summary: Sets the background color of the popover.
properties.description:
It is recommended to set this property to colorize the whole popover instead of only
its content view.

properties.name: contentView
properties.summary: View to use for the popover content. Must be set before calling the `show()` method.
properties.description:
Set this property to any [Titanium.UI.View](api:Titanium.UI.View) object, including a [Titanium.UI.Window](api:Titanium.UI.Window) or
[Titanium.UI.NavigationWindow](api:Titanium.UI.NavigationWindow) object.

This property does not support the [Titanium.UI.iOS.SplitWindow](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.SplitWindow) or [Titanium.UI.TabGroup](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup) objects.

When this property is set to a valid object, the popover **does not include the navigation
controller** unless it is set to a [Titanium.UI.NavigationWindow](api:Titanium.UI.NavigationWindow) object.

In an Alloy application, you can specify this property as a `<ContentView>` child element
of the `<Popover>` element:

``` xml
<Alloy>
    <Popover>
        <ContentView>
            <Window title="Popover">
                <Label>Popover!</Label>
            </Window>
        </ContentView>
    </Popover>
</Alloy>
```

properties.name: passthroughViews
properties.summary: Passthrough views to use when the popover is shown.
properties.description:
Specify view objects that the user can interact with while the popover is open. While
interacting with these view, the popover will not be dismissed.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary:
Display properties to use when hiding the popover.
Note that the default here is equivalent to passing in `{ animated: false }`

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary:
Display properties to use when displaying the popover.
Note that the default here is to be animated.

inlined.name: ShowPopoverParams
inlined.description:
All properties are optional except you need to specify the `view` property for the `show()`
method to attach the popover to a view component.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Indicates whether to animate showing the popover.

properties.name: rect
properties.summary:
Sets the arrow position of the popover relative to the attached view object's dimensions
when showing the popover.
properties.description: Setting the x, y coordinates to (0, 0) places the popover in the top-left corner of the view object.  Set both the `width` and `height` properties to 1.
properties.default: All dimension properties are set to zero.

properties.name: view
properties.summary: Attaches the popover to the specified view when showing the popover.

events.name: hide
events.summary: Fired when the popover is hidden.
